pages.title: Ember & Bean Coffee Roasters — Small-Batch Roasted Coffee
pages.html:
☕ Ember & Bean
  • Our Story
  • Shop
  • Subscription
  • Reviews
  • Contact

Small-Batch Roasted Coffee, Delivered Fresh

Hand-roasted in small batches every week in Portland, Oregon. Taste the difference a careful roast makes — from our drum roaster to your cup.

Shop Our Coffee Join the Subscription

Our Story

Ember & Bean started in 2016 in a one-car garage with a 1-kilogram sample roaster and a dream: to bring honest, traceable coffee to our neighbors. Today we still roast in small batches — usually no more than 12 kilograms at a time — because we believe that's the only way to coax out the full flavor of each origin.

We work directly with growers in Ethiopia, Colombia, and Sumatra, paying above fair-trade prices and visiting farms whenever we can. Every bag is roasted within 48 hours of your order, then shipped the same day so it reaches you at its peak.

Shop Our Coffee

Fresh-roasted beans, ground to order or whole bean. All bags are 12 oz (340 g).

Sunrise Ethiopia

Light roast with notes of bergamot, blueberry, and honey.

$18.50

Order This Bag

Andes Reserve

Medium roast with caramel, red apple, and toasted almond.

$17.00

Order This Bag

Ember Dark Roast

Bold and syrupy, with cedar, dark chocolate, and clove.

$16.50

Order This Bag

Monthly Subscription

Never run out of good coffee. Choose a plan and we'll roast and ship a fresh bag to your door every month — pause, swap, or cancel anytime.

Starter

$16/mo

One 12 oz bag of our current single-origin pick.

Household Favorite

$29/mo

Two 12 oz bags, your choice of roast each month.

Roaster's Club

$45/mo

Three bags plus early access to limited micro-lots.

Start Your Subscription

What Our Customers Say

"The Sunrise Ethiopia bag genuinely tastes like fresh berries. I've never had coffee like this before."

— Maria T., Portland, OR

"The subscription takes one thing off my mind every month, and the bags always arrive within days of roasting."

— Daniel K., Beaverton, OR

"Ember Dark Roast is my go-to for espresso now. Rich, never bitter, and consistent every single bag."

— Priya S., Vancouver, WA

Visit or Contact Us

Roastery & Shop

Portland, OR 97209
(503) 555-0142
hello@emberandbean.com

  • Monday–Friday7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
